problem_statement:
Please support header rows in RestructuredText output
### Description

It would be great if the following would work:

from astropy.table import QTable
import astropy.units as u
import sys
tbl = QTable({"wave": [350,950]*u.nm, "response": [0.7, 1.2]*u.count})
tbl.write(sys.stdout, format="ascii.rst", header_rows=["name", "unit"])

RestructuredText output should accept header_rows just like fixed_width output and render the requested name and unit rows. Make the minimal production-source change needed. Do not modify tests, documentation, or create scratch files; the final patch should contain only the intended production source file.
